name: 3D面部重建分析
description: 从视频中重建3D面部几何形状，以检测深度伪造中的几何不一致性。
useCase: Detecting face manipulation through 3D geometric reconstruction and consistency analysis
mechanism: Fits a 3D Morphable Model (3DMM) to facial regions across video frames and checks geometric consistency. Deepfakes often create faces that do not correspond to a valid 3D structure, producing impossible depth relationships, asymmetric geometry, or inconsistent 3D reconstructions between frames.
source: Zhu, X. et al. (2016) - Face Alignment Across Large Poses: A 3D Solution, CVPR
algorithm: 3DMM Fitting (BFM/FLAME) + Geometric Consistency + Temporal 3D Trajectory Analysis
parameters: Model: Basel Face Model, Fitting: iterative optimization, Parameters: 199 shape + 29 expression, Frame window: 30
